title: Aranmanai
desc: A family returns to their hometown to sell their ancestral palace. However, their arrival is marred by supernatural events, and Ravi, a relative of the family, decides to uncover the truth.

title: Kodeeswaran
desc: An honest man is mistaken for his twin brother, a notorious thief and is forced into a dangerous game of evasion as he tries to clear his name while uncovering the truth behind a major robbery.

title: Magic Oven
desc: A renowned chef shares and demonstrates the method to prepare various delicious recipes that can be easily made at home.

title: Villu
desc: Pugazh wants to exact revenge against JD and his friends for killing his father, Major Saravanan, a patriotic army officer who was accused of being a terrorist.

title: Yashoda
desc: Surrogate mother Yashodha is advised to follow a few guidelines to keep herself and her baby healthy and safe. However, something happens at the surrogate centre that puts both of them at risk.

title: Shanmukha
desc: A law officer and research scholar investigate an ancient Indian temple's enigmas, tracking scriptures and folklore. Thus, they uncover deity secrets and hidden forest treasure.

title: Dheeran Adhyayam Onnu
desc: A police officer is assigned the task of solving the mystery behind a series of murders. Upon thoroughly investigating, he discovers a common thread that binds all the murders together.
